title: Delicious Ukrainian Dumpling Stew
description: A hearty stew made with Ukrainian dumplings, mellow flavors, and a kick of cheonggukjang.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Cheonggukjang and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, water, and Ukrainian dumplings. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the dumplings are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
